cause: Two pre-execution reviews found contract-design errors before any formal result existed. The first draft used the later winner-v3 variable-configuration vector instead of the protected winner-v2 max_action_delta initializer. The second draft then reapplied the same projection after the protected graph, which changed float32 outputs by up to one ULP and could not satisfy bit-exact identity.
corrected_rule: Use the selected winner-v2 deployment action vector already stored in both protected G1/T2 checkpoints: [5.24,5.24,1.5,1.5,1.5,5.24,5.24,5.24,5.24,5.24,5.24,1.25,1.0,1.25] rad/s. The exact-zero initialization exports an explicit false adapter-enabled initializer and bypasses the new projection byte-for-byte; nonzero-head stress enables the adapter and must pass the graph-owned projection.
